title: One-step transition of the advice machine
statement: Let $w$ be a finite bit string, let $q$ be one of four states, and let $i<|w|$. One step of the fixed advice-ones machine from state $q$ with its input head at position $i+1$ is exactly the configuration obtained by applying to that configuration the action prescribed by the machine's transition rule for state $q$ and the bit at position $i$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the advice-ones machine, so its role can only be identified descriptively.
